sentences: The title means "breaking the stillness," and that is exactly what happens.
On a lazy spring afternoon in a farmhouse yard, a wild cat dashes off with a chick in its mouth.
The mother hen flaps after it in desperate pursuit while the other chicks scatter in every direction.
The man of the house lunges off the wooden veranda swinging his long tobacco pipe, and his wife rushes out barefoot behind him.
Even mid-escape, the cat glances back at the chaos it has caused, completely unbothered.
Kim Deuk-sin, who carried on Kim Hong-do's style of genre painting, freezes one ridiculous second of village life so well that you can almost hear it.
